reviewMethod: Read every witness in a 10,000-character complete-case context.

Retested exact actor separately from respondent, case figure, quoted voice, anthology compiler, and unnamed interlocutor.
Retested #0g deployment, recurrence, public prose, senses, depth controls, and independent storage work IDs.
Bound verdicts to current entry and worksheet hashes in the placeholder-ban ledger.
